tasks.title: Fix failing theme icon assertions in App.test.tsx
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Fix two failing test assertions in App.test.tsx that check toggleButton.textContent for emoji strings ('🌙' and '☀️'), but the Calculator renders Lucide SVG icons (<Moon /> and <Sun />) — not emoji text — causing those assertions to fail and the QA validation to report a broken auth layer.

2. READ FIRST: Read src/App.test.tsx (lines 55-84 for the failing icon tests), src/components/Calculator.tsx (the theme toggle button renders <Moon /> / <Sun /> Lucide icons, not emoji), src/components/Calculator.test.tsx (see how it asserts on SVG icon presence using toggleButton.querySelector('svg.lucide-moon')).

3. FILES: Modify src/App.test.tsx only. No other files need changes.

4. APPROACH: Replace the two emoji-based textContent assertions with SVG presence checks that match the pattern already used in Calculator.test.tsx. For the light-mode test (currently expects '🌙'), assert that toggleButton.querySelector('svg.lucide-moon') is not null. For the dark-mode test (currently expects '☀️'), assert that toggleButton.querySelector('svg.lucide-sun') is not null. Do not change any other tests — the auth flow tests (renders login by default, shows calculator after login, shows error on invalid credentials) are correct and must remain unchanged.

5. PATTERNS: Follow the SVG icon assertion pattern from src/components/Calculator.test.tsx — use querySelector('svg.lucide-moon') and querySelector('svg.lucide-sun') instead of checking textContent for emoji characters.
